tasks.title: Collect billing and usage data
inputs: Confirmed problem statement, scope, periods, RMB 8,000 budget baseline
outputs: Raw source snapshot of bills/usage plus documented data gaps
tasks.responsibility: Gather per-project/period itemized bills with project tags, token/model call detail, digital-employee runtime, shared-resource allocation records; record data gaps.

tasks.title: Validate scope and billing integrity
outputs: Validated dataset with exclusions and integrity findings
tasks.responsibility: Verify per-project/period coverage, exclude trial-project fees, check duplicate billing and allocation-caliber errors; flag missing tags/records.

tasks.title: Summarize validated costs
outputs: Cost summary with comparability notes and open gaps
tasks.responsibility: Summarize validated costs by project/period with partial-month vs full-month budget comparability caveats; no equal-period claims.

tasks.title: Test candidate cost drivers
inputs: Validated data and summary from t2-validate, t3-summarize
outputs: Factor analysis distinguishing evidence-backed vs untested causes
tasks.responsibility: Examine usage, unit price, model mix, runtime resource config, duplicate billing, allocation errors, trial-fee mixing; mark each as supported/unproven by evidence.

tasks.title: Draft evidence-based October recommendations
outputs: Recommendations with evidence links, impact, risk
tasks.responsibility: Propose 2026-10 adjustments only where evidence supports, with impact and risk; state gaps where evidence is insufficient.

tasks.title: Render final analysis report
outputs: Final read-only report for human review
tasks.responsibility: Compile report covering data validation, factor findings, recommendations, remaining data/resource gaps; no fabricated results.

semantics.title: 星河客服（正式项目）2026-09模型与数字员工费用偏高分析规划
boundaries: Read-only data collection and analysis planning.
No guessing trial-fee share; missing tags/allocation records must be filled first.
Data and resource gaps must be listed when bills are unavailable.
Resource readiness and business results are not asserted.

requirements.name: Cost analysis digital employee
requirements.purpose: Execute read-only data collection, validation, analysis and reporting tasks
requirements.preparation: Provision employee with billing-data access; resource not yet available

requirements.name: Billing and allocation data sources

business_rules: Scope: official project 星河客服 only; exclude trial projects and their fees under same account.
Fees limited to model API and digital-employee compute; exclude salaries and software purchase.
Observation 2026-09-01..09-20 Asia/Shanghai (partial month); recommendation 2026-10-01..10-31; budget baseline RMB 8,000 (latest correction, 10,000 voided, unverified).
No equal-period comparison between 20-day observation and full-month budget.
Bills, token/model breakdowns, runtimes, shared-resource allocation records not provided; actual spend and overrun unknown.
Report no fabricated spend, unproven causes, or savings; recommendations only with evidence, plus impact and risk.
Planning only: no Assignment/Run/TaskRun, no execution or config changes; human acceptance is outside tasks.
